best_epoch_rule: minimum validation ADE, earliest epoch on exact tie; report paired FDE of that epoch
capacity_rule: Historic vs NoUpdate exactly same parameters; current MLP and uniform independently trained; dead scoring modules counted separately
convergence_rule: relative train loss decrease in final five epochs < 2%; diagnostic only, not proof of optimum
groups: original Stage2p5 groups plus all history bins and entrant neighbor groups
initialization: unchanged full random H3 template truncated to H1; shared encoder/projection/carry/fusion/decoder identical per seed; new route modules initialized afterwards
interpretation: paired three seed development differences, no significance/generalization claim; independent training vs inference separated
metrics: K1 ADE/FDE meters; fixed final-horizon FDE mask
negative_controls: Routing-Random independently trained: same receiver indegree, same scene, reliable source, no self/no duplicates; explicitly relax radius4; fixed hash of history positions for reproducible random ranking
relation_intervention_legality: all: continuous same-scene no-self no-duplicate history endpoints; nonlocal controls explicitly relax4m radius

selection_rule.memory_evidence: Routing must beat equal-parameter NoUpdate best ADE by >=0.5%; otherwise receiver policy only candidate
selection_rule.primary: best ADE <= 0.99 * both PedBase and DynamicRN; paired FDE <= 1.01 * both; full8 ADE <= 1.01 * PedBase
selection_rule.ranking: qualified by overall ADE then paired FDE; maximum2; seeds17/42/2026 fixed; no seed retries
selection_rule.targeted: one-frame+neighbors ADE <= 0.90 * PedBase (>=10 evaluable targets), overall ADE/FDE <= 1.01 * both refs, full8 ADE <= 1.01 * PedBase

stop_rule: if no candidate passes first-round criteria, do not run round2; stop adding modules; analyze failure
time_control: one-hop only; edge GRU causal prefixes; no added social orders
